definitions.explanation: One particular aspect or facet of something that has multiple dimensions. Used when acknowledging that there is more to something than what is being discussed.

definitions.gloss: entire surface, as far as the eye can see
definitions.explanation: Describes a wide area completely covered or filled with something. Often used for natural scenes like fields of flowers or snow.

examples.japanese: それは{問題|もんだい}の{一面|いちめん}にすぎない。
examples.english: That is only one aspect of the problem.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}には{優|やさ}しい{一面|いちめん}もある。
examples.english: He also has a gentle side.

examples.japanese: {厳|きび}しい{上司|じょうし}だが、{部下|ぶか}を{大切|たいせつ}にする{一面|いちめん}も{持|も}っている。
examples.english: He is a strict boss, but he also has a side that values his subordinates.

examples.japanese: {一面|いちめん}の{雪景色|ゆきげしき}だった。
examples.english: It was a snowscape as far as the eye could see.

examples.japanese: {春|はる}になると、この{丘|おか}は{一面|いちめん}{菜|な}の{花|はな}で{黄色|きいろ}く{染|そ}まる。
examples.english: In spring, this hill is dyed yellow with rapeseed flowers as far as the eye can see.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}の{後|あと}、{庭|にわ}は{一面|いちめん}{水浸|みずびた}しになっていた。
examples.english: After the typhoon, the entire garden was flooded.

notes:
{一面|いちめん} has two distinct uses. Sense 1 ("one aspect") focuses on a partial view of something multifaceted. Sense 2 ("entire surface") describes a wide expanse covered uniformly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
Sense 1:
- {意外|いがい}な{一面|いちめん} (unexpected side)
- 〜の{一面|いちめん}もある (also has a ~ side)
- {問題|もんだい}の{一面|いちめん} (one aspect of the problem)

Sense 2:
- {一面|いちめん}の{銀世界|ぎんせかい} (a world of silver — snow everywhere)
- {一面|いちめん}に{広|ひろ}がる (spread across the entire surface)
- {一面|いちめん}の{花畑|はなばたけ} (a field of flowers as far as the eye can see)

USAGE NOTES:
- In newspapers, {一面|いちめん} also means "front page" ({新聞|しんぶん}の{一面|いちめん})
- Sense 2 often appears as an adverb directly modifying a noun: {一面|いちめん}の{雪|ゆき}
